source.title: Aiobahn +81 feat. KOTOKO - INTERNET OVERDOSE (Official Music Video) [Theme for NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE]

r2_reuse.framehash_note: framehash.md5 uses output-time pts (0,512,...) from the muxer; source pts must come from showinfo-window.log mapping (source n = 5610 + counter, pts = 2872320 + counter*512). All 60 framehash md5 values are unique (no duplicate frames in this window).

read_log.method: one original PNG per image-tool call; screening sheet not used as locator for claims

subphases.desc: onset: single MMD figure (woman, headband) heavily distorted with neon pink/green/cyan chroma-edge glow, pixel block noise; glow/blur onset
exposure dip: same layout, mean drops 155->65 (iskey:1 at n5613); heavily pixelated dark horizontal bands, figure barely visible
row of 5-7 MMD figures emerges through glitch; white/pale costumes, pink background, row of hearts at top; figures mirrored left-right
text ANGEL appears in large pixel font across center; color flicker: red-pink -> yellow-green (white outline, dark shadow offset) -> rainbow CA

main ANGEL scene: 4 MMD characters (blonde, green/mint outfits) dancing in row; ANGEL text overlaid center; text color cycles per-frame (green->dark purple->rainbow->white/orange->green/white->white/silver->yellow-green->white); text jitters (n5647); hearts float above heads; purple/blue pixelated city background
text ANGEL absent; 5-6 figures in green/mint outfits, shy pose (hand over mouth); background spiral decorations
brightness spike: scene overexposed (mean 158), white overlay, pink/purple tint; faces partially visible through white wash
clearer: 4 blonde MMD girls in white/mint sailor uniforms, blue eyes, dancing; glitch decreasing
transition: new layout (legs top, gray band center, row of faces bottom); heavy vertical glitch bands; block fragmentation; central dark silhouette with arms raised

shot_B.label: inverted purple-head character + tiled collage
shot_B.desc: figure with purple/spherical head (green face pattern), orange/red torso, teal legs; oscillates upside-down (n5665,5666,5668,5669) and upright (n5667); chaotic tiled collage background (hearts, gift shop, pink/green/blue pixel noise); RGB split on tiles

scene_structure.cut: explicit cut between shot A and shot B at n5664/n5665; no cross-fade

typography.legibility: readable in most frames; n5623 (red, heavy pixelation) and n5627 (dark purple) are low-contrast/uncertain; n5650-n5652 text absent
typography.script_hierarchy: single word, dominant size (~40% frame width, ~15% frame height), no secondary text in this window

glyph_anatomy.A: triangular top, thick diagonal strokes, horizontal bar near bottom; small triangular counter
glyph_anatomy.N: two vertical strokes + diagonal; no counter
glyph_anatomy.G: rounded C-shape with bar/notch at right; partial counter
glyph_anatomy.E: three horizontal bars + vertical stem; no counter
glyph_anatomy.L: vertical stem + bottom horizontal; no counter

typography.stroke_contrast: minimal - uniformly thick (heavy display/block font); no thin/thick modulation
typography.joins_terminals: square/block terminals; no serifs; joins are 90-degree mitered
typography.counters: small, mostly filled; A has small triangular counter; G has partial counter; N/E/L have no counters
typography.spacing: tight; letters nearly touching; no kerning visible
typography.fill: flat per-frame discrete color (no within-frame gradient except rainbow phase); color cycles per-frame: white/orange, green, teal, yellow-green, purple, rainbow, dark
typography.outline: white or dark stroke, varies per-frame; present in most frames
typography.shadow_extrusion: n5624 shows dark drop-shadow offset (bottom-right); no continuous extrusion
typography.internal_texture: horizontal segment stripes (ladder pattern) visible in white phase (n5630, n5640, n5660); pixel block noise in glitch frames
typography.channel_offsets: strong RGB split (chromatic aberration) on many frames, especially n5625, n5649, and glitch frames
typography.appearance_mechanism: per-frame discrete opacity (1/0) - text appears n5623, disappears n5650, absent through n5669; not a fade
typography.position_jitter: slight horizontal/vertical jitter (n5647: text shifts right, A partially clipped at left edge)

material_composition.figures: 4-7 MMD-style characters in a row; mirrored left-right around center; dance poses change every 1-2 frames (high tempo); blonde hair, green/mint/white outfits, blue eyes (n5659+); pink hair in earlier frames (n5620)
material_composition.hearts: small pixel hearts floating above figures' heads; pink/teal; present in n5618-n5646
material_composition.background: purple/blue pixelated city silhouette (night); spiral decorations (n5650-52); tiled collage in shot B
material_composition.letterbox: black bars left/right (content is ~16:9 within 960x720 4:3 frame)
material_composition.bg_fg_order: text in front of figures; hearts in front of figures; text above figures' heads
material_composition.empty_space: background city provides negative space; figures occupy center-lower; text occupies center-upper

static_artistic_variation: text color cycle (discrete per-frame, not smooth)
glitch intensity varies (CA amount, block size, displacement)
character orientation oscillation (shot B: upside-down vs upright)

constructions.name: mirrored figure row
constructions.observed_pixels: 4-7 MMD characters in a row, mirrored left-right, dancing, poses change every 1-2 frames
constructions.proposal: single figure layer (2D rig or per-frame sprite) + mirror duplicate (flip left half to generate right half); pose driven by keyframe track; spacing/offset editable
constructions.lyric_emotion_fit: fits upbeat, playful, group-affection lines (dancing row + hearts); avoid slow/melancholic lines (motion tempo too high)
constructions.reading_risks: figure motion may distract from text if text is in the same region; mirror symmetry may read as 'copy-paste' if figure poses are identical
constructions.image_relation: figures are behind text; hearts are in front of figures; text is above figures' heads
constructions.transition: explicit cut to shot B; no cross-fade; flash (n5653-58) is a transition device

constructions.name: ANGEL text
constructions.observed_pixels: 5-letter all-caps pixel/block font, ~40% frame width, centered; per-frame discrete color cycle; per-frame opacity on/off; slight jitter; white/dark outline; internal ladder stripes; drop shadow (n5624); glow; RGB split
constructions.proposal: text layer with block/pixel display font (or vector glyph artwork); fill = keyframed solid color (per-frame discrete, not gradient); outline = stroke pass (keyframed); internal stripes = horizontal-line mask/overlay clipped to text; drop shadow = offset duplicate behind (dark); glow = blur + additive layer behind; CA = RGB channel offset (keyframed); appearance = per-frame opacity keyframes (1/0); jitter = small random positional offsets
constructions.lyric_emotion_fit: short single-word lyric (ANGEL) fits compliment/affection/electronic themes; color flicker fits high-energy/fast-tempo sections; avoid long text (only short words fit the size); avoid slow lines (flicker is too high-energy)
constructions.reading_risks: text flickers and disappears - for sustained lyric readability, pin color cycle to high-contrast state (white on dark); rainbow/CA phases reduce legibility; tight spacing may make letters run together at small sizes
constructions.image_relation: text is in front of figures, above figures' heads; text does not occlude faces
constructions.transition: text appears n5623 (hard in, no fade), disappears n5650 (hard out); flash (n5653-58) precedes text absence

constructions.name: global glitch pass
constructions.observed_pixels: pixel block noise, strong RGB split, block displacement (datamosh-like), exposure dip (n5613-16), brightness spike (n5653-58), vertical glitch bands (n5663-64)
constructions.proposal: pixelation = downscale + upscale (nearest) with keyframed block size; CA = RGB channel offset (keyframed); block displacement = slice displacement (approximate datamosh; not native in most 2D tools - may require pre-rendered sprites or plugin); exposure dip = per-frame brightness keyframes; flash = white overlay opacity (keyframed); vertical bands = keyframed mask/strip displacement
constructions.lyric_emotion_fit: fits electronic/digital/internet themes (title: INTERNET OVERDOSE); glitch intensity can track energy (high glitch = high energy); avoid for intimate/quiet passages (glitch is too aggressive)
constructions.reading_risks: heavy glitch reduces text legibility (n5623, n5625); exposure dip (n5613-16) makes scene nearly unreadable; flash (n5653-58) washes out details
constructions.image_relation: glitch pass is global (applied to all layers); it is continuous across the shot A/B cut (both shots have CA + block noise) - provides continuity
constructions.transition: glitch is the shared continuity device across the cut; it does not transition, it persists

constructions.name: tiled collage background (shot B)
constructions.observed_pixels: grid of tiles (3x3+), each tile = crop from a source image; per-tile RGB split, hue shift; hearts, gift shop, pink/green/blue pixel noise
constructions.proposal: grid of tile layers (3x3+), each tile = a crop from a source image; per-tile: RGB split (keyframed), hue shift (keyframed); tile content is editable (swap crops); grid size editable
constructions.lyric_emotion_fit: fits chaotic/overloaded/internet-surfing themes; avoid for calm/ordered passages
constructions.reading_risks: high visual noise - text over this background needs strong contrast (white + dark outline); tile content may distract
constructions.image_relation: tiles are background; character is in front; tiles do not move (static grid) while character oscillates
constructions.transition: explicit cut from shot A; no cross-fade

constructions.name: inverted character (shot B)
constructions.observed_pixels: figure with purple/spherical head (green face pattern), orange/red torso, teal legs; oscillates upside-down (n5665,5666,5668,5669) and upright (n5667)
constructions.proposal: single character layer (2D rig or sprite); rotation keyframed 0/180 degrees (oscillation); pose keyframed; character content editable
constructions.lyric_emotion_fit: fits playful/absurd/upside-down themes; inversion is a comic device; avoid for serious/grounded passages
constructions.reading_risks: inversion may confuse if the character's identity is important; oscillation frequency should match tempo
constructions.image_relation: character is in front of tiled collage; character is centered
constructions.transition: explicit cut from shot A; no cross-fade

constructions.name: heart layer
constructions.observed_pixels: small pixel hearts floating above figures' heads; pink/teal; present n5618-n5646; bob/flicker
constructions.proposal: small pixel heart sprite, instanced above each figure's head; per-instance: vertical bobbing (sine wave), opacity flicker; heart count, bob amplitude/frequency, color editable
constructions.lyric_emotion_fit: fits affection/playful/romantic lines; hearts are a universal 'love' symbol; avoid for non-affectionate passages
constructions.reading_risks: hearts may clutter the space above figures if too many; bob frequency should not conflict with text flicker
constructions.image_relation: hearts are in front of figures, above figures' heads; hearts do not occlude text
constructions.transition: hearts present in shot A, absent in shot B (explicit cut)

continuity.text: ANGEL text is only in shot A; absent in shot B - explicit cut; no text continuity across the cut
continuity.scene: background city (A) vs tiled collage (B) - explicit cut; no scene continuity
continuity.texture_noise: glitch pass (CA + block noise) is continuous across the cut - both shots have the same global glitch; this is the shared continuity device
continuity.camera: no clear camera movement within shot A (fixed framing); the re-layout at n5661-64 is a cut/transition, not a camera move; shot B has no camera movement

ae_export_gaps.editable_text_shaping: AE text layer + block font is fine; internal ladder stripes require a mask/overlay (not native to AE text); vector glyph artwork is editable in AE (shape layers)
ae_export_gaps.masks_materials: per-frame discrete color cycle = keyframed solid colors (AE supports); horizontal-line mask clipped to text = AE mask + track matte (doable, not one-click); drop shadow = AE drop shadow effect (native)
ae_export_gaps.effects_alpha_color: glow = AE blur + additive blend (doable); flash = white layer opacity (doable); pixelation = downscale + upscale (doable, but quality depends on interpolation setting); CA = AE channel offset / RGB split (doable); datamosh-style block displacement = NOT native in AE (requires plugin or pre-rendered sprites)
ae_export_gaps.camera_coordinate: fixed framing, no camera - no AE camera needed; 2D layer positioning is sufficient
ae_export_gaps.runtime_parity: UNTESTED - proposed recipes are visual approximations; per-frame pixel match to source is not guaranteed; each recipe step needs validation in the target tool
ae_export_gaps.native_support_baking_proxy: NOT ASSUMED - each recipe step must be validated in the target tool; no silent assumption of native support, baking, or proxy fallback

counterexamples: n5650-n5652: text absent - if a recipe assumes continuous text, it fails here
n5613-n5616: exposure dip - if a recipe assumes constant exposure, it fails here
n5653-n5658: brightness spike - if a recipe assumes no flash, it fails here
n5665-n5669: shot B has no text - if a recipe assumes text in all shots, it fails here
n5667: character upright (not inverted) - if a recipe assumes constant inversion in shot B, it fails here
unresolved_evidence: exact color cycle sequence is not fully deterministic (per-frame observation, no source data for the cycle algorithm)
jitter amplitude/frequency is not precisely measured (visual estimate only)
figure pose keyframes are not extracted (visual observation only, no skeleton data)
tile content in shot B is not identified (no source image for the tiles)
heart bob frequency is not precisely measured (visual estimate only)
the 'ladder stripes' in the text are not confirmed to be a separate mask layer (may be part of the font glyph artwork)
notes: All 60 frames were read individually; no screening montage was used for claims
The framehash.md5 uses output-time pts (muxer), not source pts; source pts come from showinfo-window.log
All 60 framehash md5 values are unique (no duplicate frames in this window)
The text 'ANGEL' is the only readable text in this window; no other glyphs were identified
The figures are MMD-style 3D characters; an appearance suggesting 3D may have an original 2D construction; this does not establish the author's software, graph, or use of MMD
Scene/person repetition or dance remains useful scene reference and never counts alone as a text-animation form
